notes.title: Demo Update !
notes.notes:
[b]Patch note time ![/b]

- We've updated a lot of VFX, they look awesome now (almost all of them)

- New QOL improvements : Your screen will be tainted in BLOOD when you're low health now. New announcer when the nigth is near ! New announcer when your Monolit is under attack !

- A whole new world of icons for the game (Buildings and Menu).

- Rework of Tier3 Weapons (Pickaxe, Hammer, Sword and Staff) to make them all end-game playable.

- New Victory and Defeat screens !

- Tutorial reworked !

- A LOT of bugfixes

[b]With love from Gravity Studio[/b]
